Your Impact

As Channel Partners Program Manager, you will operate and help build Axon's international Partner Program from the ground up, keep the systems and data behind those relationships clean and reliable, and enable distributors and in-market Axon teammates day-to-day. International distributors play a critical role in Axon's international markets and are viewed as valued partners, not simply distributors. Reporting to the Sr. Director of International Sales Ops, you'll act as a key program operations contact, supporting distributor relationships in coordination with local and regional Axon teams.

This is an execution-focused role: hands-on program operations with real input into how the Partner Program is structured and scaled as it grows.

Partner Program Development

- Own the design and rollout of a formal partner strategy and program  — defining structure (tiers, requirements, benefits, etc.) and documenting program guidelines.

- Define and track program participation and performance metrics — reporting to stakeholders and communicating program updates, requirements, and milestones to distributors.

- Drive design and execution toward the program’s primary objective — distributors who support customers effectively, operate independently, and contribute to scalable growth across markets.

Partner Systems & Data

- Own day-to-day administration of Axon’s distributor-facing platform(s) and pipeline systems, including user access, setup, and configuration.

- Support internal teams to efficiently resolve distributor questions, support requests, and escalate as needed.

- Gather feedback from distributors and relay it to the appropriate internal teams to inform program and process improvements.

Partner Commercial Support

- Enable distributor-led orders, ensuring accuracy and timely inclusion in the sales pipeline.

- Support distributors through order fulfillment — coordinating with order management, fulfillment, and other internal teams to resolve blockers and keep distributors informed on status.

Cross-Functional Program Operations

- Coordinate with internal teams to align program rules, support expectations, and escalation paths across Sales, Marketing, Product, GRO/RMA, PSO, and Compliance.

Lead the Engineering Program Management Organization

Own Portfolio-Level Program Execution

- Oversee execution of the Devices product development portfolio from early concept through product launch.

- Maintain visibility across program schedules, dependencies, risks, budgets, resources, and major development milestones.

- Identify systemic risks and cross-program dependencies early and drive resolution with Engineering, Product, and Operations leadership.

- Establish mechanisms that provide leadership with clear, objective visibility into portfolio health and enable timely decision-making.

- Step into critical programs when necessary to help teams resolve ambiguity, remove roadblocks, and establish a credible path forward.

Your Impact:

Dedrone stands out as the global leader in airspace defense technology and counter-UAS solutions. Engineering at Dedrone is tasked with delivering innovative solutions and products to maintain our position on the cutting edge of innovation.

Engineering Program Managers, Solutions at Dedrone own the delivery of next generation cUAS engineering solutions from requirements definition through deployment, driving programs that are highly visible to even the most senior executives. This role sits at the intersection of product, internal engineering, and external development partners: taking requirements from product management, aligning them with internal technical teams, and directing outside development partners (ODM/CM and technical solution providers) to design, develop, and deliver the resulting engineering solutions.

This role emphasizes vendor and program management, requirements translation, partner alignment, and cross-functional execution across the full solutions development lifecycle. The ideal candidate combines strong hardware program management fundamentals with hands-on experience managing external development partners, ensuring that vendor-delivered work meets technical requirements, schedule, and quality bars.

What You'll Do:

- Translate product requirements from Product Management into clear technical scopes, then align internal Systems, Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering teams and external development partners around a shared execution plan.

- Own the master schedule for solutions programs delivered in partnership with outside development partners (ODM/CM and technical solution providers), driving milestones across all program phases (EVT, DVT, PVT).

- Serve as the primary program interface to external development partners — managing scope, technical reviews, and deliverable acceptance to ensure vendor output meets Dedrone's requirements.

- Identify, track, and proactively mitigate program risks from partner capability gaps and long-lead component constraints to supplier qualification gaps before they become schedule or cost impacts.

- Own program budget management including NRE, tooling, and build costs, maintaining alignment between vendor commitments and business objectives.

- Collaborate regularly with both domestic and international stakeholders, including ODM/CM and other development partners, to ensure manufacturing readiness and on-time production ramp.

- Translate complex technical status, vendor tradeoffs, and program risk into clear, actionable communication for executive and cross-functional audiences.

- Work autonomously and collaboratively in an empowering and fast-paced environment, driving clarity in ambiguous situations.

- Hone your program and vendor management expertise in a dynamic learning environment focused on personal and professional development.

What You Bring:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field; MBA or MS in Engineering Management a plus.

- PMP certification a plus.

- Proven experience managing hardware or technical solutions programs delivered through external development partners, preferably in industries involving advanced electromechanical systems.

- Strong technical fluency across mechanical, electrical, and firmware disciplines sufficient to translate product requirements, evaluate vendor tradeoffs, and engage meaningfully with internal engineering teams.

- Demonstrated experience managing ODM/CM or outside development partner relationships, including scoping, technical reviews, deliverable acceptance, and coordinating manufacturing readiness activities such as yield, regulatory certification, and factory acceptance.

- Familiarity with hardware build phases (EVT/DVT/PVT), design freeze processes, and the tradeoffs inherent in transitioning from development to production.

- Proficiency with program management tools for scheduling, risk tracking, and cross-functional coordination.

- Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., FCC, CE, UL, MIL-STD) and experience driving vendor-delivered products through certification processes.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to identify critical path risks — including those originating with external partners — and drive resolution across competing organizational priorities.

- Excellent communication skills to effectively align product managers, internal engineering teams, and external development partners, surface tradeoffs to leadership, and present program status with clarity and confidence.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with high levels of ambiguity and evolving requirements.

- Lead cross-functional Operations readiness reviews and ensure critical deliverables are completed prior to key program and build milestones.

- Own Supply Chain readiness for development builds and product launch, including material planning, component availability, supplier readiness, lead-time management, capacity assessment, and mitigation of supply risks.

- Proactively manage Axon’s reputation and enhance brand visibility by responding to emerging issues, managing crises, and securing strategic media placements.

- Collaborate with the corporate communications team to ensure that messaging is consistent, timely, and relevant for both external audiences and internal stakeholders.

- Partner with government affairs teams to support advocacy efforts and policy initiatives, positioning Axon as a leader in the public safety industry.

- Collaborate with our events and digital teams to plan, manage, and execute in-person, hybrid, and webinar events.

- Create and implement integrated marketing campaigns that include case studies, video content, digital campaigns, and public relations strategies.

- Manage regional brand presence, including in online channels (social, web)

- Drive new, creative approaches to reach key audiences and personas using various channels and content mediums.

- Depending on market needs, develop locally relevant marketing strategies or adapt existing, proven frameworks.

- Track ROI, engagement, and audience feedback to refine and optimize campaign and event strategies.

- Provide strategic insights into Axon’s go-to-market motion and competitive positioning to create and progress opportunities.

- Create and deploy field-facing enablement assets, sales playbooks, and content that aligns with priority selling scenarios.

- Develop and execute strategies in partnership with the sales team to promote cross-sell and upsell opportunities.

Manage Relationships

- Collaborate with agency partners to coordinate media outreach, co-marketing initiatives, and customer reference opportunities.

- Manage internal relationships to build cohesive product launch plans, adapt content for local markets, and support the sales team in achieving their goals.

- Foster strong ties with public relations, public affairs, and external communications teams to ensure a unified, impactful message across regions.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

- 7+ years of marketing experience, ideally at a public safety, SaaS or technology company

- Experience developing and executing marketing strategies and managing external or in-house agencies

- Expertise in digital/growth marketing, events and public relations or public affairs

- Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to speak and write English fluently
